description: Create or replace the calling app's schema and index configuration. All configured fields are declared top-level properties; uniqueKey, when set, is a required indexed string matching ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$ on every record. Core validates writes to registered collections and maintains typed field values in shared expression indexes. Existing incompatible records or duplicate values return 409 before activation. An omitted auditActions retains the app-wide catalog; a supplied array replaces it and action names must be unique. The response includes the effective catalog. Unregistered collections retain schemaless writes.

summary: Upsert a record by its unique key
description: The collection must declare a uniqueKey and data must contain the exact case-sensitive path value. Creating a record returns 201 and may omit If-Match. Replacing an existing record returns 200 and requires If-Match, including while holding its lock. An If-Match for a key with no matching record version returns 412. A lock held by a different caller prevents replacement. Replay the same key, body and precondition to recover the original result.

headerParameters.name: Idempotency-Key
headerParameters.description: Required UUID for this write. A missing or malformed key returns 400 invalid_request. Core retains the first recorded result for 24 hours, scoped to the verified tenant and caller, HTTP method and concrete request path. Within that window, the same key and logical request replay the first status, body and resource headers without another write. A changed body or write precondition for the same key returns 422 idempotency_key_reused. Concurrent identical requests share one result; every replay requires current authorization.

headerParameters.name: If-Match
headerParameters.description: Send the exact strong ETag from the record response. Required when the request replaces existing data. Atomic increments and creation by unique key may omit it. If supplied, a missing or stale record version returns 412.

description: Apply 1–50 creates, replacements, deletions or atomic increment operations in request order in one transaction for the calling app. Every replace and delete requires ifMatch with the current record ETag, even for a schemaless collection or its lock holder. Each increment item applies one or more increments to one record using the atomic PATCH rules and may omit ifMatch. The batch key covers all items. Locks held by other callers block edits and deletes, including increments. Each result matches its input position. Deletes have version null. A failure rolls back the entire batch. Schema violation paths point into the matching operation in the request.

summary: Replace record data or increment numeric fields
description: The data form replaces the complete data object and checks schema and uniqueness. The operations form is the only edit that may omit If-Match, because it updates server-side without a client read. An If-Match supplied with operations must still match. An Idempotency-Key is required for operations. A lock held by a different caller blocks either form. An increment uses the current value of a declared top-level numeric indexed field. by, min and max are numbers. Bounds are optional and inclusive, and min must be at most max. A nonnumeric or absent value, an ineligible field or inverted bounds returns 400. Process increments in array order and apply them together in one database statement. A bound failure returns 409 limit_exceeded with the field name. A successful write increments the record version once and validates the resulting data against the collection schema. Strict mode requires If-Match for replacements. Compatibility mode accepts its omission and preserves the legacy replacement body. An atomic increment always returns a versioned body.

headerParameters.name: If-Match
headerParameters.description: Send the exact strong ETag from the record response. Required when the request replaces existing data. Atomic increments and creation by unique key may omit it. If supplied, a missing or stale record version returns 412.

headerParameters.name: Idempotency-Key
headerParameters.description: Required when the PATCH body contains operations. The planned Idempotency-Key replay and 24-hour retention rules apply when a key is supplied.

summary: Acquire or renew a record lock
description: The owner app may acquire an exclusive lock for 300 seconds by default, up to 1800 seconds per request. Core binds the lock to the verified app and, when present, its verified delegated user. To renew an active lock, send its lockId in the body and a fresh Idempotency-Key. Renewal sets the expiry relative to the renewal time and retains the lockId. Acquiring without lockId while already holding the active lock returns that lock without extending it. A stale lockId returns 409 resource_conflict. A lock held by another caller returns 423. Core checks the active lock in the same transaction as each record mutation. Locks expire automatically and leave the record ETag unchanged.

description: Only the holder of the active lock may release it, using the exact Lock-Id. Administrators cannot force release. If the record exists and has no active lock, return 204. headerParameters.name: Lock-Id
